audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED ABILITY NAME, used as the matchup's whole focus. "Repeating Dashes" is not an Ambessa ability. Her kit is Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). The invented name appears in winCon, enemyWin, ahead, loading, focus.text, phases[3].why, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.trading, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.difficulty, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[1].t, report[3].t, report[5].t, report[9].t, report[10].t, report[12].t and report[13].t. spikes[0].text adds two more: it calls her Q "Cursed Wave" and labels Sundering Slam as her E — Sundering Slam is the transformed second cast of her Q, and E is Lacerate.
audit.why: The real interactions are all in Riot's text and none of them were on the page. Cunning Sweep is a semicircle; striking an enemy transforms the next cast into Sundering Slam, a LINE in front of her — so the dodge changes from backing away to stepping sideways. Repudiation (18/17/16/15/14s) shields her, braces, and "if she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing, this ability will deal increased damage" — feeding damage into the brace makes it hit you harder, which is the exact opposite of what a Mundo instinctively does. Public Execution (130/115/100s) blinks to the farthest champion in a line, suppresses, then slams and stuns. Drakehound's Step grants a dash plus bonus attack range, damage, attack speed and an energy refund — no shield and no stacks, which is what whys[2] and spikes[0].text claimed.
audit.corrected: Every writable field carrying "Repeating Dashes" now names Public Execution or Repudiation; spikes[0].text now names Cunning Sweep, Sundering Slam, Repudiation and Lacerate correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two level charts disagree with each other and with the whys[] prose. content win[] read Skill / Dr. Mundo / Dr. Mundo / Skill / Skill / Dr. Mundo / Dr. Mundo while whys[0..3] all say Ambessa and whys[4..6] all say Dr. Mundo; the packet chart is Ambessa x4 then Dr. Mundo x3. Dr. Mundo wins 47.43% over 1301 games, so the early stages cannot be his.
audit.why: Ambessa's Q at 650 range, her shield and her two dash sources beat a level-1-to-3 Mundo with nothing but passive regen. The lane turns at 6 when Maximum Dosage arrives and again at the first health item. I set Levels 4-5 to Skill rather than Ambessa because the already-written mirror audit records that Ambessa's own page calls 4-5 her weakest stage — her Q is 12s and E 11s there against a 4s Infected Bonesaw — and the two pages must not contradict.
audit.corrected: Levels 1, 2 and 3 to Ambessa (4/10); Levels 4-5 stays Skill at 5/10; Level 6 to Dr. Mundo; first item and 2+ items raised to 6/10. Proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number for Public Execution or Maximum Dosage appeared anywhere, and phases[4].why was generic template copy on a stage whose side field was wrong.
audit.why: Maximum Dosage is a flat 120s at every rank against Public Execution's 130/115/100s, and it heals a percent of MISSING health instantly. That is the whole level-6 spike: you hold R for her blink rather than spending it on chip. The mirror audit asked for exactly these numbers on both pages.
audit.corrected: winCon, breakdown.mid, breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[2].d now carry 130s and the flat 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: SECOND FABRICATION: "Q cleaver ... for the slow + HP refund" in tradeGood, breakdown.early, breakdown.trading, report[3].t and dosFull[1].d, plus "your Q heal" in whys[5], spikes[2].text and late. Infected Bonesaw has no healing in Riot's text — it deals damage based on the target's current health and slows. THIRD FABRICATION: wants.you[1] says "E-stun her follow-up dash". Blunt Force Trauma is not a stun.
audit.why: The heal in Mundo's kit is Heart Zapper: it stores a portion of damage he takes and heals a percentage of it ONLY if the burst hits an enemy. Against three dash sources at 325 range that condition is the entire counterplay, and the mirror audit flags it as absent from both pages. Infected Bonesaw scaling on CURRENT health also inverts the advice — poke her while she is full, not while she is low.
audit.corrected: All heal claims moved onto Heart Zapper with its hit condition; the stun claim removed.

notes: The worst data in the slice so far: an ability name that does not exist, used as the matchup's tracked cooldown in 22 fields. "Repeating Dashes" is not in Ambessa's kit; the tracked ability should be Public Execution (R, 130/115/100s) or Repudiation (W, 18s at rank 1). spikes[0].text carried two more name errors — her Q called "Cursed Wave" (really Cunning Sweep) and Sundering Slam labelled as her E (it is the transformed second cast of her Q; E is Lacerate). CANNOT FIX: focus.text is "Ambessa Repeating Dashes", 24 characters, which is under the applier's 25-character floor, so the fabricated name will survive there and on the loading screen focus line unless someone changes it by hand or the floor is bypassed. That is the one field the user must fix manually. Also killed the "Q heal / HP refund" fabrication (8 fields) and an "E-stun" (wants.you[1]) — Infected Bonesaw has no heal and Blunt Force Trauma has no stun; the heal is Heart Zapper's, and only if the burst connects. Content credited Ambessa's passive with "healing off her passive stacks": Drakehound's Step grants a dash, bonus attack range, damage, attack speed and an energy refund — no heal, no stacks. Per the mirror's open question I did NOT assert that Public Execution's suppression pierces Goes Where He Pleases, and I did not assert the reverse either — every field now says to bait the passive out first, which is correct whichever way that resolves. Her R carries a heal flag in the kit file that Riot's description does not support; I wrote nothing from it.
